label: Perfection of being: thin reading versus intensive reading
resolution: The registered premises d164b1ff and c4fb87a6 use the primitive OfBeing and leave its reading open. PERFECTION_OF_BEING_1 (ThinOfBeing): only being itself; on it d164b1ff holds trivially and c4fb87a6 fails for life and wisdom. PERFECTION_OF_BEING_2 (IntensiveEsseFrame.OfEsse): a perfection of esse itself; on it c4fb87a6 is R-act₂ (IntensiveEsse). Reception of esse in essence (R-act₁) does not settle which reading holds: the ModeOfBeingMiddleTerm controls satisfy R-act₁ with the reception and purity interfaces while R-act₂ fails on the thin reading. No statement relates the two senses.
